items.name: state-button
items.title: State button
items.description: Save, progress, and confirmation in one button.
items.docs: Import { StateButton } from your configured components alias under bera/state-button. Keep its companion CSS. Use the host save callback through onAction. Preserve validation, disabled state, and retry rules. Never use the simulation as real persistence. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/state-button.agent.md

items.name: sliding-tabs
items.title: Sliding tabs
items.description: Switch views with a selection that follows your lead.
items.docs: Import { SlidingTabs } from your configured components alias under bera/sliding-tabs. Keep its companion CSS. Connect value/onValueChange and supply items. Keep each tab associated with its existing panel. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/sliding-tabs.agent.md

items.name: morphing-menu
items.title: Morphing menu
items.description: Turn a compact trigger into a menu of actions.
items.docs: Import { MorphingMenu } from your configured components alias under bera/morphing-menu. Keep its companion CSS. Supply actions with onSelect callbacks and a label. Preserve menu focus and keyboard behavior. In an existing Radix menu, adapt the surface motion instead of replacing the primitive. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/morphing-menu.agent.md

items.name: text-swap
items.title: Text swap
items.description: Keep changing statuses readable and connected.
items.docs: Import { TextSwap } from your configured components alias under bera/text-swap. Keep its companion CSS. Connect the status index with value; supply statuses with text and icons. Keep a single polite announcement for a meaningful change. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1; radius does not apply. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/text-swap.agent.md

items.name: expanding-search
items.title: Expanding search
items.description: Open a search field without leaving your place.
items.docs: Import { ExpandingSearch } from your configured components alias under bera/expanding-search. Keep its companion CSS. Connect value/onValueChange and optionally open/onOpenChange. Only direct interaction moves focus; external disclosure updates and controlled replay preserve it. onSearch submits the query. Supply actual searchable items or replace demonstration result rendering. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/expanding-search.agent.md

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast stack
items.description: Layer notifications without taking over the screen.
items.docs: Import { ToastStack } from your configured components alias under bera/toast-stack. Keep its companion CSS. Adapt the stack geometry to the existing toast provider. This reference uses a local Preview toast control; preserve the host provider's lifecycle, expiry, pause, live region, and dismissal semantics. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/toast-stack.agent.md

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy feedback
items.description: Copy a command. Confirm it right where you clicked.
items.docs: Import { CopyButton } from your configured components alias under bera/copy-button. Keep its companion CSS. Pass the exact text. Confirm only after the clipboard write succeeds and preserve the manual fallback. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/copy-button.agent.md

items.name: rolling-counter
items.title: Rolling counter
items.description: Give changing quantities a sense of direction.
items.docs: Import { RollingCounter } from your configured components alias under bera/rolling-counter. Keep its companion CSS. Connect value/onValueChange and the allowed range. The reference supports 0–999; adapt digit count explicitly for larger ranges or signed values. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/rolling-counter.agent.md

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Reveal details with a coordinated height and content transition.
items.docs: Import { Accordion } from your configured components alias under bera/accordion. Keep its companion CSS. Supply items and connect value/onValueChange if controlled. Keep the heading/panel relationship and make closed interactive content inert. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/accordion.agent.md

items.name: morphing-icon-button
items.title: Icon morph
items.description: Connect open and close with the same SVG strokes.
items.docs: Import { MorphingIconButton } from your configured components alias under bera/morphing-icon-button. Keep its companion CSS. Connect pressed/onPressedChange to the actual panel state. Keep the stable label and existing focus management. Forward aria-controls to the panel and preserve host dismissal behavior. Replay changes only the icon, never the application state. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/morphing-icon-button.agent.md

items.name: radix-menu-motion
items.title: Radix menu motion
items.description: Add motion to the menu you already have.
items.docs: Import the CSS and opt the existing menu content into the adapter. Preserve the host's trigger, items, handlers, portal, placement, and focus behavior. Remove competing animation utilities only from the opted-in content. No UI primitives or packages are installed. Read the adaptation guide: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/adapters/radix-menu-motion.agent.md. Live example: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/integrations/radix-menu.
